title: Rise Path lesson review (review.v1)
description: What a reviewer (pedagogy-reviewer, ja-editor, visual-qa, a CI judge or a human) returns for one lesson, scored against content/schema/rubric.v1.json. Round 1 is a full review; a later round may be a fix-verification round ("mode": "verify", rules in .claude/skills/review-lesson/SKILL.md). Hand-written; usable with `claude -p --json-schema`. Check one or more reviews with `node .claude/skills/review-lesson/scripts/check-review.mjs <file>…`.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the reviewed file, e.g. content/courses/vibe-coding/drafts/vibe-ch1-practice.lesson.json.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed: pedagogy-reviewer, ja-editor, visual-qa, ci or human:<name>.

mode.description: full (the default when absent): the whole lesson is reviewed and every criterion in scope is scored afresh. verify: a fix-verification round that checks the previous review's must-fix items and reviews what changed since it; it needs `verifies` and `resolved`.

verifies.description: Verification rounds only: what this round verifies. Copy reviewedRevision, changed, changedShare and fullReviewRequired from `review-scope.mjs <file> --since <revision>` and add previousReview.

reviewedRevision.description: The lesson revision the previous review read: a git commit, or sha256:<hash> from `review-scope.mjs --snapshot`.

previousReview.description: The review this round verifies: a path (for example the snapshot copy under .artifacts/review/) or <commit>:<path>.

changed.description: What changed since reviewedRevision, as review-scope.mjs lists it: block ids, section.<id> for section fields, lesson.<field> for lesson fields. Each was reviewed in full.

changedShare.description: Share of blocks changed, added, removed or moved since reviewedRevision (0–1). Above 0.3 a full review is required.

fullReviewRequired.description: The review-scope.mjs decision. A verification review is valid only when it is false.

resolved.description: Verification rounds only: one entry per open must-fix item of the previous review (its mustFix, plus its resolved entries marked unresolved). check-review.mjs counts every unresolved entry as an open must-fix.

blockId.description: The blockId of the previous must-fix item.

status.description: resolved: the change removes the problem completely. unresolved: not applied, applied only in part, or the problem moved elsewhere.

evidence.description: One or two sentences that quote the current text (or name the screenshot) and show why.

scores.description: One entry per criterion in the reviewer's scope. pedagogy-reviewer scores all 13; ja-editor and visual-qa score the criteria they can judge. A verification round lists every criterion the previous review scored: the re-scored ones, and the others with carriedOver: true.

evidence.description: One or two sentences that quote the lesson or name block ids.

carriedOver.description: Verification rounds only: true when score and evidence are copied unchanged from the previous review because the changes do not affect this criterion. Absent or false: scored in this round.

mustFix.description: Changes required before the lesson can pass. Each fix is specific enough to apply without guessing. In a verification round: only errors in changed or new blocks, or regressions the changes caused elsewhere (the issue names the change).

blockId.description: Block, section or objective id; "lesson" for lesson-wide issues.

screenshot.description: visual-qa only: the PNG that shows the issue, relative to the preview folder.

average.description: Mean of the scores given. Optional; check-review.mjs recomputes it.

verdict.description: pass: every scored criterion ≥ 3, mean ≥ 3.3, no mustFix and no unresolved item. revise: fixable. reject: wrong audience or outcome; needs a rewrite.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the author: the biggest strength and the most important fix.
